fuse/post_filter_on_transform::bigquery:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    orders.status AS `orders___status`,
    DATE_TRUNC(orders.ordered_at, MONTH) AS `orders___ordered_at`,
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS FLOAT64) AS `m`
  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    orders.status,
    DATE_TRUNC(orders.ordered_at, MONTH)
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    `orders___status`,
    `orders___ordered_at`,
    `m`,
    CAST(SUM(`m`) OVER (PARTITION BY `orders___status` ORDER BY `orders___ordered_at`) AS FLOAT64) AS `x`
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  `orders___status`,
  `orders___ordered_at`,
  `m`,
  `x`
FROM (
  SELECT
    `orders___status`,
    `orders___ordered_at`,
    `m`,
    `x`
  FROM step1
  WHERE
    `x` > 50
) AS _outer
ORDER BY
  `orders___status` ASC NULLS LAST,
  `orders___ordered_at` ASC NULLS LAST
